findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the result lines to stay compact at 1280x720. Actual: with side pots the result block has four columns (title, Pot winners, Winners, Shown hands), so 'Hand over' wraps onto two lines and 'Ava shows · Pair of queens' squeezes into a narrow, wrapped column. Still readable and no horizontal overflow, so the spec's criterion is met.
findings.fix: Optional: let the result block wrap, or stack Pot winners above the row, so labels do not wrap mid-phrase.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the render tests to pin how a split side pot appears in the rendered result. Actual: the rendered Pot winners line re-joins winner texts in the component, separately from the model's text, and no render or browser test renders a split pot. Changing the rendered separator goes undetected. Behaviour is correct today: the Judge saw split lines render 'Ben wins $41, Ava wins $40'-style text.
findings.fix: Add a render assertion for a split side pot, or render p.text parts from the model so there is one source of the separator.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Spec interface says HandResultView.pots is a required array, [] for a single pot. Actual: the property is optional and omitted for a single award (deviation recorded so the locked whole-object assertions still pass). Observable behaviour is the same: no Pot winners list.
findings.fix: None required; record the interface deviation in the story doc / spec follow-up.
